{{Quote|I'm listening to K-DROID, my favorite station.|G2-9T|<ref name="Star Tours" />}}
'''K-DROID''',<ref name="Star Tours" /> also known as '''FM Droid''', was a station that played Top 40 [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Music/Legends|music]]<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref> on frequency 109.7. It was the favorite station of [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]],<ref name="Star Tours" /> a [[G2 repair droid/Legends|G2 repair droid]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> working for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency.<ref name="Star Tours" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}} dates the [[Battle of Death Star III]], and therefore the events of [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], to 4.3 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]] according to the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|dating system]] used by sources such as ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> K-DROID broadcast "[[I Wanna Weld Your Hand]]," the latest hit from "[[Danny and the Droids]]," while G2-9T was listening to the station.<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
K-DROID was originally created for the<ref name="Star Tours" /> [[1987]]<ref name="Imagineering Star Tours">{{SW|url=news/imagineering-star-tours-part-3-visual-effects-and-disney-magic|text=Imagineering Star Tours, Part 3: Visual Effects (and Disney) Magic|nolive=1}}</ref> [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], and could be heard playing in the ride's queue.<ref name="Star Tours" /> The station was alternatively identified as FM Droid in the ''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]'', a document published by the Planning Office for [[Tokyo Disneyland]] Relations and [[Wikipedia:Panasonic|Matsushita Electric Industrial Co.]]<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" />
